hypothesis: On Friday afternoons traders cut positions that won during the week to avoid weekend risk, so a large week-to-date ES move partly reverses after 14:00; fading it at 14:00 beats side-matched random twins with the same brackets.
mechanism: Weekend gap risk cannot be hedged until Sunday 18:00 ET; inventory holders reduce winning (crowded) exposure before the close, a flow against the week's direction concentrated in the Friday afternoon.
closed_ideas_check: Not on research_loop/CLOSED_IDEAS.md or the spend ledger. Nearest: D1 daily close-to-close reversal (daily horizon, every day, 09:35 entry), E2 OpEx-week drift (calendar sign, not the week's own move), shock_fade (5m shocks). This conditions on the week-to-date move and the Friday 14:00 clock only.

rules.week: A week = sessions sharing the Monday-start week index floor((days since 1970-01-01 + 3) / 7) of bar['day']. Week open = open of the 09:30 5m bar (slot 0) of the week's FIRST session (Monday, or Tuesday after a Monday holiday).
rules.same_contract: If any session after the week's first session has bar['roll'] True (front contract changed mid-week), the week is skipped.
rules.day: Friday (bar['dow'] == 4) only; not a half day (bar['half_day']), not a roll day. No Friday session (holiday) -> no trade that week.
rules.wtd: WTD = close of the 13:55-14:00 5m bar (mod 835) - week open. Decided on that bar's close.
rules.atr: ATR20 = mean of the last 20 completed sessions' RTH true range (as F1: max(H, prev_close) - min(L, prev_close), H - L when prev_close is None). No trade until 20 TRs exist.
rules.entry: market, fills at the 14:00 open. One trade per session.
rules.bracket: stop = c - side * 0.5 * ATR20, target = c + side * 0.5 * ATR20 (1R about the decision close c).
rules.exit: stop, target, or the engine flat at 15:55.

expected_sign: positive mean net R (reversal); not weaker at larger w.
against_the_mechanism: Report only (not gated, not in budget): the same rule on Mon-Thu afternoons (day_filter='mon_thu', WTD measured to that day's 14:00). If Mon-Thu does as well (mean net R >= Friday's), the effect is a generic afternoon reversal, not weekend squaring.

Report only: split traded Fridays by the prior session's Cboe VIX close (research_loop_volsig cboe/VIX_History.csv, frozen) at the dev median of those values. If the high-VIX half carries >= 75% of a positive net R total, the effect is a volatility-regime artefact.
